mapper.sql: id, real_name, phone, id_card_no, city, rating, completed_orders, daily_capacity, today_orders, banned, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_worker WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id, worker_id, cert_code, exam_score, status, passed_at FROM t_certification WHERE worker_id = #{workerId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_worker (real_name, phone, id_card_no, city, rating, completed_orders, daily_capacity, today_orders, banned, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{realName}, #{phone}, #{idCardNo}, #{city}, #{rating}, #{completedOrders}, #{dailyCapacity}, #{todayOrders}, #{banned}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_worker SET today_orders = today_orders + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{workerId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
